name: starlight-nes-party
description: A controller-first NES board party, mini-game arcade, pack builder, and challenge creator.

scripts.build:web: emmake make -f Makefile.libretro platform=emscripten clean && emmake make -f Makefile.libretro platform=emscripten -j4 && mkdir -p public/cores/nes && em++ -std=c++17 -O3 -Isrc/drivers/libretro/libretro-common/include native/nes_web_frontend.cpp -Wl,--whole-archive fceumm_libretro_emscripten.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s ENVIRONMENT=web,worker,node -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s FILESYSTEM=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["cwrap","HEAPU8"]' -o public/cores/nes/fceumm.js
